theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} [LinearOrder α] [DenselyOrdered α] {s t : Finset α} (hs : s.Nonempty) (ht : t.Nonempty) (H : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ t, x < y) : ∃ b, (∀ x ∈ s, x < b) ∧ ∀ y ∈ t, b < y := by
  obtain ⟨x₀⟩ := hs
  obtain ⟨y₀⟩ := ht
  have : ∃ z, x₀ < z ∧ z < y₀ := densely_ordered.exists_between x₀ y₀
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := this
  use b
  · intro x
    intro hx
    exact hb.1 (H x hx)
  · intro y
    intro hy
    exact hb.2 hy
